verses.text: Conducting our lives as we should even though we are poor
Being enthusiastic but not thinking carefully about what we are about to do is not good;
Some people are ruined as a result of their own foolish actions,
Those who are rich easily find people who want to be their friends,
Those who tell lies in court will surely be punished [LIT];
Many people try to persuade important people to do favors for them;
Even the relatives of someone who becomes poor hate him,
Those who become wise [IDM] are doing a favor for themselves;
Those who tell lies in court will certainly be punished [LIT];
It is not appropriate for foolish people to live ◄luxuriously/like rich people►,
Those who have good sense do not quickly become angry;
When a king is angry, that causes people to be afraid of him, like the roar of a lion causes people to be afraid [SIM],
Foolish children can cause disasters to happen to their parents.
We can inherit a house or money from our parents when they die,
Those who are lazy sleep soundly,
Those who obey God’s commandments will remain alive for a long time;
When we give things to poor people, it is as though we are lending to Yahweh,
Discipline your children while they are young, while you still hope that they will learn to behave as they should;
Those who ◄do not control their temper/quickly become very angry► will have to endure what happens as a result;
Pay attention when people give you good advice and learn from them,
People plan to do many kinds of things,
People want others to be loyal to them;
Those who have an awesome respect for Yahweh will live a long life;
Some people are extremely lazy;
If you punish someone who makes fun of those who are wise, those who ◄are naive/need to be instructed► will learn to do what is smart;
Anyone who mistreats/abuses his father or forces his mother to leave the home
My son, if you stop learning things,
Worthless witnesses in court make fun of judges who try to make fair decisions,
God is ready to punish those who make fun of him/religion;
